headline: Motilal Oswal analyzes growth revival prospects as Tata Elxsi plunges 70% from its peak
hook: Severe correction in high-multiple tech stock
summary: Mid-tier IT services firm Tata Elxsi has witnessed a significant correction, trading down 70% from its all-time highs. Brokerage firm Motilal Oswal has released an evaluation questioning whether the company can engineer a growth revival from current levels. The steep decline reflects slowing growth momentum and multiple compression in high-valuation engineering R&D stocks. Indian retail investors holding the stock face prolonged consolidation as the brokerage weighs structural versus cyclical pressures.
whats_next: Motilal Oswal research note release and upcoming quarterly earnings
why_it_matters: Long-term tech investors face severe wealth erosion from peak valuations.
